The following vcpkg-tool releases have occurred since the last registry release:

  • https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg-tool/releases/tag/2026-09-26

In those tool releases, the following changes are particularly meaningful:

  • Fix x-add-version to be as transactional as its error messages suggest (and 1/10th the time) by @​BillyONeal in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2050
  • [curl] propagate VCPKG_SSL_REVOKE_BEST_EFFORT to spawned processes by @​mem16k in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2098
  • Fix binary cache precheck result mapping by @​miyanyan in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2112
  • Do not replace registry errors with " does not exist" by @​bugale in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2095
  • Add apple as a valid platform expression by @​cqundefine in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2121
  • Audit for git commands that can accept more --. by @​BillyONeal in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2118
  • Match xbox expressions to CMake definitions by @​BillyONeal in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2124
  • Standardize binary cache upload failure diagnostics by @​xiaozhuai in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2105
  • Make binary cache ZIP compression level configurable by @​xiaozhuai in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2125
  • [export] Get vcpkg.exe into the nupkg. by @​BillyONeal in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2134
  • Gracefully fallback to WinNET proxy settings when HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY are malformed by @​camillebruckmann in microsoft/vcpkg-tool#2137
